_comment_00_logging: Logging: JSON log_level is applied after --config loads; CLI --log-level/--verbose/--quiet still override it.
_comment_01_basic_training: Basic training: iterations, SH schedule, learning rates, RGB+SSIM loss mix.
_comment_01b_pose_refine_switch: Camera pose refinement (per-camera SO3xR3 deltas): master switch + parameterization mode. All pose_refine_* below are inert while refine_camera_pose=false.
_comment_01c_pose_lr_schedule: Pose LR schedule (nerfstudio camera_opt mirror, measured on global iteration): init lr -> lr_final exponential decay, with optional sin() warmup from lr_pre_warmup. warmup_steps=0 skips ramp; max_steps=0 falls back to total iterations.
_comment_01d_pose_regularization: Pose L2 regularization weights on the rotation/translation deltas (keeps poses from drifting too far).
_comment_01f_pose_safety_and_log: Pose safety clamps (per-camera accumulated rotation/translation caps) + diagnostics cadence.
_comment_02_gaussian_init_and_limits: Gaussian init and limits: initial opacity/scale, random init settings, capacity, tile mode. mesh2splat_max_cap_extra_ratio=0 keeps fixed max_cap; 0.05/0.10 means 5%/10% headroom over mesh2splat initial GS count.
_comment_03_mcmc_refine: MCMC refine: relocation/refill cadence, active interval, pruning threshold, opacity/scale regularization.
_comment_04_mesh_surface_regularization: Mesh-surface constraints: mesh-init hard projection plus soft mean/scale/normal losses and an optional one-sided outside barrier; mesh_depth_visibility_cull controls whether behind-mesh GS are removed before alpha blending.
_comment_05_mesh_gt_depth_normal: Mesh GT depth/normal: renders mesh supervision targets for pseudo-view, mesh losses, and debug outputs.
_comment_06_pseudo_view_cells: Pseudo-view stage 1: mark real-camera sphere cells and emit pseudo views from empty cells.
_comment_07_pseudo_view_pose: Pseudo-view stages 2-3: sphere-cell directions, surface target selection, and candidate camera pose filters.
_comment_08_pseudo_view_rgb_and_masks: Pseudo-view stage 4: choose source RGB, filter target/source face angles, reproject, build supervision masks, and save outputs in parallel.
_comment_09_eval_and_outputs: Evaluation and outputs: eval switch, eval image saving, depth/normal debug image saving.
_comment_10_masks_and_background: Masks and background: project_mesh uses mesh projection as mask; random background samples per-pixel colors.
_comment_11_optional_filters_and_color: Optional image/color modules: mip filter, bilateral grid, PPISP.
_comment_13_misc_schedule: Misc schedule: steps_scaler<=0 disables step scaling; pyramid_training=false disables resolution pyramid.
_run_command: Run-GS.exe -d Colmap regist results --> tex_data_inc_image_full -o Same output of swaptexture --config path to mcmc_optimization_params.json --mesh-init-gs-scene path to ColorMapping ply+png or obj+mtl+png
